scope: Required fields for any future measured electrode run; missing public inputs are not imputed

required_fields.electrode_batch: unverified for independent replicate identity in extracted source traces
required_fields.support: see original SI; not treated as matched across papers
required_fields.membrane: see original SI; trace-specific mapping not independently audited
required_fields.liquid_composition: see original SI; trace-specific mapping not independently audited
required_fields.current_potential_timeseries: numeric source records preserved, with current-axis normalization caveat
required_fields.product_flow_and_purity: no synchronized raw trace paired with these stability files
required_fields.stop_reason: end of published record; failure event not identified
required_fields.maintenance_events: not obtained in synchronized trace form

synthetic_buffer_convention: storage_charge_h denotes deviation from common initial 2 rated hours of qualified-product buffer; physical stock=2+deviation is bounded0..4 and final stock equals initial stock
schema_does_not_imply: That the publication omitted these details; only this bounded audit has not established the trace-specific mapping
